FN-SAWD878-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 124
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Crawford
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/08/2024
House Bill 124as introduced would decrease sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund by
an undetermined amount annually dependent on the amount of gross receipts derived from the
sale of certain fence material used for the purpose of fencing in agriculture livestock
applications.

FN-SAWD878-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 124
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Crawford
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/10/2024
House Bill 124as reported by the committee on Ways and Means Education would decrease
sales tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund, beginning in Fiscal Year 2025 through Fiscal
Year 2029, by an undetermined amount annually dependent on the amount of gross receipts
derived from the sale of certain fence material, up to $25,000, used for the purpose of fencing in
agriculture livestock applications.
In addition, this bill could also decrease sales tax receipts to counties and municipalities by an
undetermined amount dependent on if the local government adopts the exemption provided by
this bill.
